title: Light Serene of Holy Glory
description: Light Serene of Holy Glory in Tonic Solfa to ALL FOR JESUS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns of the Greek Church (Edinburgh and London, 1900), where he gives them as “By Athenogenes, 296 A.D”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), and this page sets them to ALL FOR JESUS; any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Light se-rene of ho-ly glo-ry From th'Im-mor-tal Fa-ther poured, Ho-ly Thou, O Bless-ed Je-sus, Ho-ly, Bless-ed, Christ the Lord.

lines: Now we see the sun descending,
And in hymns we praise the Father,
Son and Spirit, God of Might.
Christ the Son of God art Thou;
For Thy gift of life eternal,
See the world adores Thee now.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Greek Church (1900)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Greek Church; set to ALL FOR JESUS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
